findings.summary: The Markdown table reader keys tables by header, so two tables with identical headers in one section would keep only the last.
An indented table is not seen as a table and the separator row is not checked; a reformatted required table still fails loudly.
The contract's Implemented-by columns, section 5 and its rule bullets are not machine-checked, which no criterion asked for.
The How-to-use test matches phrases by substring, so a rewording that keeps the phrases but flips the meaning would pass.
The contract gives the alert expression only as a sentence, leaves three annotation texts to the rule file, and repeats service.name for the probe, so the machine file resolves each by reading.
